comment: Approvals > Activations reconciliation (scripts/lib/activation_reconcile.py). Per governance packet under docs/ops/packets/<id>/: live_when = checkable facts that mean the packet was applied (lane registry row values, n8n live list membership, a commit in the served release); policy_base = the AGENTS.md version a policy package was built on (a different served version supersedes it).

Every check true -> Resolved: Already live. policy_base moved -> Resolved: Superseded. Otherwise the packet stays waiting and the queue names the failing check. Packets not listed stay waiting with 'no activation target declared'. Resolved packets are shown behind a toggle, never deleted.
Optional per packet: title, proposed_by (override when the README and its commit name nobody), note (shown with the evidence).
